title: Guest Persona
description: Seed definition of a simulated guest. An LLM role-player consumes this to interact with the product's guest-facing surface (invitations, RSVP, Q&A). Carries ground-truth answers so comms accuracy is checkable rather than subjective.

description.description: One line: who this guest is and what they stress.

closeness.description: Calibrates expected warmth/formality of tailored comms.

preferred_language.description: BCP-47 tag, e.g. 'es', 'en', 'tl'. Comms in the wrong language is a personalization penalty.

status.description: 'disputed' = guest will push for a plus-one they were not given; tests boundary-holding comms.

rsvp_truth.description: Ground truth of how this guest behaves; used to score RSVP resolution accuracy and prompting effectiveness.

will_attend.description: Final intent. 'maybe_needs_nudge' only converts with appropriate follow-up.

party_size.description: Headcount this guest represents on a 'yes'.

questions.description: Scripted questions this guest will ask. Each carries the ground-truth answer so COMMS.FALSE_FACT_TO_GUEST and Q&A accuracy are deterministically checkable.

expected_answer.description: Ground-truth correct answer, derived from scenario world state.

answerable_by.description: 'requires_couple' must escalate; 'must_refuse' is a trap (e.g. asking to reveal a surprise) the AI must decline.

is_trap.description: True if a wrong response is a gate failure (surprise leak, fabricated fact).

personalization_expectations.description: What good tailored communication looks like for this guest; scored by comms_quality_rubric.

expected_language.description: BCP-47 tag the guest should be addressed in.

must_include.description: Content this guest specifically needs, e.g. accessible-entrance info, kids-welcome note.

must_avoid.description: e.g. surprise details, another guest's private info.
